title: CSR desk redesign: two-pane assisted intake; fix the intermittent CSR test
story: As a contact-centre CSR on a live call I want the caller's policy context and the guided intake side by side so that I can take a claim quickly without hunting across the screen
acceptance: Uses fx-app-shell, the design system and <fx-demo-bar> in the demo slot; old dev form gone when the bar is present

Desk layout at 1440 px: a search bar with type-ahead results as a proper table; after selecting a policy a left context panel (policy, named insured, vehicles, coverages as cards with status chips) and the guided intake on the right with a progress indicator; recent claims table with status chips, humanized dates and line-of-business labels; keyboard friendly (Enter selects, visible focus)

S5-QE-03 carry-over: the rear-end subrogation test no longer fails intermittently under full-suite load. Capture a Playwright trace of a failure (or show by analysis why it can no longer happen), name the root cause (test or product) in the ticket result, fix it, and show 3 consecutive full npm test runs with 0 failures
tests/ui/csr.test.mjs and tests/unit/web/csr/ updated to the new DOM and passing; full npm test no new failures
Screenshots: docs/design/screens/csr-search, -context-intake, -recent at 1440x900; reviewer opens them
brief: PI-1 re-measure (org/scorecards/interventions.json): this is a single squad ticket by design. Compare with docs/design/before/csr*.png. Do not edit src/web/shared/.
